description: SEPTA service alerts, advisories, detours, and suspensions for Philadelphia transit. Pass a route to check one line: a bus number ("23"), a trolley ("T1" or legacy "10"), a Regional Rail line name ("Paoli/Thorndale", "West Trenton", "Airport"), a subway ("Broad Street Line", "Market-Frankford Line", "NHSL"), or a raw route_id ("bus_route_23", "trolley_route_10", "rr_route_pao"). Omit route to list every route with an active alert system-wide. Example: septa_alerts({ route: "Paoli/Thorndale" })

route.description: Route to check. Bus number ("23"), trolley ("T1" or "10"), rail line name ("Media/Wawa", "Trenton"), subway ("MFL", "BSL", "NHSL"), or raw route_id ("rr_route_pao"). Omit for all active alerts.
